name: Tai Shu-lun
bio: Tai Shu-lun is dated by Giles to the 9th century AD. His poem here is a New Year’s Eve alone at an inn.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: New Year's Eve at an Inn
poems.author: Tai Shu-lun
poems.text:
Here in this inn no friend is nigh;
We sit alone, my lamp and I,

A thousand miles from love and smiles,
To see another year pass by.

Ah me, that ever I was born!
Is life worth living, thus forlorn?

Youth, beauty, pass; and yet alas
It will be spring tomorrow morn.
